title: Desktop app: clipboard manager
description: Clipboard history with search/pin, tray icon + menu, global shortcut Ctrl+Alt+V, badge count.

title: Desktop app: code editor
description: Tabs, file tree, syntax highlighting (JS/TS/HTML/CSS/JSON/MD/Rust/GLSL/TOML), find & replace, multi-cursor, quick open — CodeMirror 6 + window.nord.desktop.

title: Desktop app: notes
description: Notes as files in the app data folder: search, reorder, autosave, import/export dialogs, reminders (notifications), dark-mode follow, en/de.

title: Desktop app: file organiser
description: Pick a folder, sort files into folders by type/month with preview + undo, find duplicates (SHA-256), virtual table for 10k+ files.

title: Desktop app: markdown editor
description: Split view CodeMirror + live sanitised preview (marked), open/save/export HTML, drag-drop, file association for .md.

title: UI app (Todo)
description: Plain HTML/JS app with a tiny DOM kit — todo list with persistence. Swap in any library app kit.

title: Desktop app: local web server
description: Serve a folder over HTTP: live reload, SPA fallback, CORS, directory listing, request log + graph — window.nord.desktop.server.

title: Endless one-button (Flappy)
description: Scrolling obstacles, one-button control, score and restart.

title: FPS arena
description: First-person controller (mouse look, sprint, crouch, jump), hit-scan weapon, destructible targets.

title: Idle / clicker
description: Currency, upgrades with cost scaling, per-second income, offline progress, autosave.

title: Puzzle (Match-3)
description: Swap-and-match core: board, cascades, refill, score and move limit.

title: Card game (Memory)
description: Card grid with flip animation, matching logic, move counter and win state — DOM UI based.

title: Platformer
description: Tilemap level, hero with coyote time/variable jump/dash, enemies you can stomp, coins, checkpoints, boss, HUD.

title: 3D platformer
description: Third-person-ish 3D platformer: coyote jump, double jump, moving platform, gems, respawn.

title: Racing (time-trial)
description: Arcade car, checkpoints, lap timer, best lap saved, chase camera.

title: Endless runner
description: Auto-running character with jump/duck, obstacles, speed ramp and distance score.

title: Grid game (Snake)
description: Tile-based game loop: timed steps, grid entities, food, game over.

title: Shooter (Space)
description: Side-scrolling shooter: player ship, bullets, waves of enemies, score and game over.

title: Top-down adventure
description: Rooms, NPC dialogue, inventory, key + door, pickups, chasing enemies, HUD.

title: Tower defense
description: Path, waves of creeps, click-to-build towers with range and fire rate, gold and lives.

title: Visual novel
description: Branching dialogue from a JSON file (library dialogue script): speakers, typewriter text, choices.

title: Rust 2D game
description: macroquad + rapier2d runtime, scenes in JSON, scripts in Rust (builds to WebAssembly).

title: Rust egui app
description: eframe/egui app that runs natively and in the browser (wasm-bindgen, no trunk).

title: Rust Bevy game (optional)
description: Slim Bevy 0.16 app (WebGL2): spinning cube starter. Runs natively and in the browser via the wasm-app export path; own ECS, no Nord scenes.

title: Platformer (event sheet)
description: Platform behavior, coins, slimes, a turret and a goal — everything is an event sheet. The tutorial T24 game.

title: Top-down shooter (event sheet)
description: WASD + mouse aim, bullets, chasing enemies, score and lives — no scripts, all event sheet + behaviors.

title: Endless runner (event sheet)
description: Auto-run, jump over obstacles, speed ramp, distance score — event sheet + Platform/Bullet behaviors only.

title: Lights Out puzzle (event sheet)
description: Grid puzzle with instance variables, picking by expression and a solvable shuffle — pure event sheet.

title: Menu starter (event sheet)
description: Main menu, options (language + volume) and a game scene, wired with game events and string tables (English/Finnish).
